relationships.evidence_quote: This case illustrates a severe and complex SCN9A‐related painful neuropathic disorder associated with the de novo p.Ile234Thr variant.

relationships.subject: carbamazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: carbamazepine was introduced and progressively titrated to 200 mg three times daily, resulting in more than 90% pain improvement

key_findings: De novo SCN9A p.Ile234Thr (Nav1.7 gain of function) in a patient with heat-triggered paroxysmal pain, small-fibre loss and autonomic dysfunction.
Carbamazepine produced more than 90% pain improvement, supporting genotype-guided therapy.
